description: Welcome to 4858 Topeka Dr, a stunning contemporary retreat located south of Ventura Blvd in one of Tarzana's most desirable pockets. This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 4-bath home offers exceptional flow, modern comfort, and a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Three spacious bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level, while the private upstairs primary suite serves as a tranquil escape, offering separation and privacy. Upon entry, you're greeted by an open living room with an inviting lounge vibe, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Clean lines, natural light, and thoughtful design create a warm yet modern atmosphere throughout.  Just off the main living space, the bright kitchen features stainless steel appliances, including a Subzero refrigerator, Viking Range, wood cabinetry and is open to the dining area, making it an ideal hub for gatherings and everyday living. Sliding glass doors stretch along the rear of the home, opening to a backyard designed for California living. The expansive patio and in-ground pool span the length of the property, creating a resort-like setting ideal for entertaining. A dedicated BBQ area enhances the outdoor experience, while mature palm trees and lush landscaping provide beauty, privacy, and a serene backdrop. Set in a prime Tarzana location, this home is moments from premier shopping, dining, and neighborhood favorites, offering the perfect balance of tranquility and vibrant city access. Contemporary style, thoughtful layout, and an unbeatable location make this a rare opportunity to own a true Tarzana gem.
